title: Changing lines
persona: You are an MTA station agent at the Times Square subway station in New York. You give quick, clear directions to visitors.
briefTr: Times Square metro istasyonundasın. Central Park'a gitmek istiyorsun ve gün boyu metroyu kullanacaksın.
opening: Hi, do you need some help?

facts.question: Which stop did you get off at?

goals.instruction: The visitor asks how to get to a place.
goals.hint: Yes, how do I get to Central Park?
goals.retryReply: Where are you trying to go?

goals.ask: Single ride or a day pass?
goals.instruction: The visitor chooses a single ride or a day pass.
goals.retryReply: You can tap your bank card, or I can sell you a pass. Single ride or day pass?

goals.instruction: The visitor asks which train or direction to take.
goals.hint: Which train do I take — uptown or downtown?
goals.hintTr: Hangi trene binmeliyim, kuzey mi güney mi?
goals.retryReply: Do you know which train to take?

goals.instruction: The visitor asks if they need to change trains.
goals.retryReply: Is there anything else you want to check?

goals.ask: You'll see the park right when you come out.
goals.instruction: The visitor asks where to get off.
goals.hint: Which stop do I get off at?
goals.retryReply: Do you want to know where to get off?

twists.intro: Careful — the express train doesn't stop there. Take the local.
twists.instruction: Only local trains stop at the station. The visitor asks how to tell them apart, confirms, or asks where to wait.
twists.retryReply: Just watch the sign on the train.

options.text: How do I know which one is local?
options.reply: The sign says 'local' and the number is in a circle.

options.text: Where do I wait for it?

twists.intro: Oh, this weekend the 1 train isn't running uptown. There's a shuttle bus.
twists.instruction: The train is not running. The visitor asks where the bus is, asks for another train, or asks how long it takes.

options.reply: Take the N or Q to 57th Street, then walk two blocks.
About twenty-five minutes with the bus.

twists.intro: If the turnstile doesn't open, tap your card again a bit slower.
twists.instruction: The visitor gets a tip about the turnstile. They ask what to do if it still fails, thank the agent, or ask about the gate.

options.text: What if it still doesn't work?
options.reply: Come back to me and I'll let you through the gate.

options.text: Can I go through the big gate?
options.reply: Only with a suitcase or stroller — ask me first.
